paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation

model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale, ranging from 2.5 to 11.25 with a tick label interval of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", also has a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 33 with a tick label interval of 1. The four lines represent the models "Consistency-CE", "Inconsistency-CE", "Inconsistency-CE-MP", and "Consistency-Bi". The "Consistency-CE" line is purple, dashed, and marked with circles, starting at approximately (2.5, 26.1) and ending at (11.25, 31.6), with a steady increase. The "Inconsistency-CE" line is dark purple, dashed, and marked with squares, starting at around (2.5, 26.2) and ending at (11.25, 31.7), also showing a steady increase. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line is blue, dashed, and marked with squares, beginning at about (2.5, 25.8) and ending at (11.25, 32.0), with a similar increasing trend. The "Consistency-Bi" line is red, solid, and marked with stars, starting at approximately (3.5, 29.0) and ending at (11.25, 32.3), displaying a steady increase across the x-axis.
